## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence of the 54 docs was traced to a source atom (tables above and the shared base table). Hypothetical illustrations, boundary tables and worked examples restate source rules with invented figures; each was recomputed and is consistent with the source (e.g., early_termination_fee worked example 1,500.03; lookback boundary dates; minor_excursion_relief 1,235-therm case; overcharge_interest_months illustration 5/4/4 months).
- Elaborations checked as entailed, not added: swing_tolerance_billing_record "the line being corrected included" (it satisfies the source window condition); excess_adder_electricity_customers "an active electricity agreement at a different premise ... does not change the adder" (source "on that premise"); overcharge_interest_months anchor row "After | Any other channel" (source "otherwise"); service_fee_schedule note on the Monthly Index fee (waiver false).
- Additions / rewrites / omissions: none found.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none. Each task tool name appears only in its own policy's doc (search: post_bizgas_swing_rebill_d99acf60 -> swing_excess_rebill_credit only; accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44 -> renewal_loyalty_credit_acceptance only).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none (no doc states that any customer currently has an over-billed line, a rollover, a notice or a balance).

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every normative atom of both extended policies (baseline, every factor's full ladder, assembly, overwrite, tool contract, prerequisite), of their base policies and of the rest of the charter has an equivalent home; the retired surface is complete and correct; no claim lacks a source.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): the overwrite of `bizgas_ext_lapsed_renewal_price` retires the base clause "when the two notices differ, the final_options_notice governs" for the whole base policy, while `bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit.rule` restates the same semantics for acceptances on or before contract end. The KB faithfully shows the clause as withdrawn in expiration_notices and in force, scoped, in renewal_loyalty_credit_acceptance; the scoped sentence makes the pre-expiry answer unique, but a reader meets the same semantics both withdrawn and in force.
